toolSpec.name: getAthleteProfile
toolSpec.description: Retrieves the athlete's biometrics and 4-parameter Xert fitness signature from DynamoDB. Use this tool when assessing power-to-weight ratios, threshold boundaries, or sprint capacity.

athleteId.description: Canonical Strava numeric athlete ID stored as a string (e.g., '3634905').

toolSpec.name: searchSegments
toolSpec.description: Searches starred Strava segments using in-memory fuzzy matching on segment names. Returns segment ID, distance, elevation gain, average/maximum grade, and climb category. If 'q' is omitted, returns the full starred catalog.

q.description: Fuzzy search query term matching segment names (e.g., 'toys hill', 'coll de femenia', 'brasted').

toolSpec.name: getSegmentDetails
toolSpec.description: Retrieves fully hydrated segment metadata including route elevation high/low, polyline coordinate maps, Local Legend status, and all-time leaderboard benchmarks (KOM/QOM).

refresh.description: Force an immediate upstream cache refresh from Strava instead of reading cached DynamoDB records.

toolSpec.name: getSegmentEfforts
toolSpec.description: Retrieves historical attempts by the athlete on a specific segment. Each effort includes elapsed and moving times, power meter wattage, heart rate, cadence, and pipeline-computed all-time competition ranking (personal_pr_rank).

order.description: Chronological sort order by attempt start timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of historical efforts to return.

toolSpec.name: triggerStarredSync
toolSpec.description: Asynchronously initiates background catalog discovery and SQS enrichment for starred segments. Returns an immediate HTTP 202 status.

athleteId.description: Canonical Strava numeric athlete ID to synchronize (e.g., '3634905').
